answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A farm faking 226 aliases needs 226 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Orchard keeper log works as the check: trees tended at one orchard across years of fruit seasons. Watch the hollow: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the pulse bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the haven audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
